Click here for the original, which includes textless pages (omitted from this gallery).

Special thanks to Hirasan for editing. This one was apparently even more trouble than I thought it would be.

As the original is in Kansaiben and utterly unabashedly so, I first translated with that in mind. Unfortunately I seem to be the only person on this planet who reads the first translation with the cadence and intonation one might expect from Kansaiben. (Maybe that's why anime translators usually just do a lazy/terrible job of imitating a certain English dialect...) For this and similar reasons, I redid the translation in more standard English (pages 5-8). If you look closely, you may notice places where I thought it worked better translated a little differently.
